section_sequence.what_it_does: Full-width red pixel-condensed H1 'WHERE THINGS GET DEVELOPED' on black; below, a 4-column mono row: '[darkroom], noun' dictionary definition, manifesto paragraph, red MANIFESTO button; first work image peeks in at the fold.
~2700px section: Oreo & BTS neon-city render, Looped (purple room with big yellow countdown numerals), Ibicash dark landscape; each case titled in the same red display face over full-bleed media.
Short mono paragraph ('a small sample, just three builds') + ALL WORK button.
Red display heading over three anonymised mono quotes in columns.
'TOOLS WE BUILD AND USE. NOW YOURS TOO.' then a featured OSS card: red pixel-box graphic left, 'SATUS LENIS HAMO TEMPUS' list + description right.
Two-line red display statement + short paragraph and GET IN TOUCH button.
Four mono columns: Services, Clients, Technologies, Awards.
Heading then a long dated changelog table (date | category | entry) in tiny mono rows.
LET'S TALK button, world-clock times, nav/OSS/social/inspiration link columns, then a huge 'DARKROOM' wordmark with scanline texture; persistent bottom bar 'BECOME AN OPEN SOURCE SPONSOR'.
Scrolling past the footer on mobile reveals a full-screen red panel reading 'YOU'VE FOUND THE DARKROOM BACKROOMS.' in the display face.

motion.observed: No visible change across t=0-8s; only a thin red bar at the right edge (likely a scroll-progress indicator, inferred).
The media strip at the fold grows to fill the viewport in the next frames, with the title pinned top-left over it.
Big yellow numeral changes 2 -> 1 (desktop) and shows 2 on mobile while the frame holds: a countdown video or pinned panel.
desktop-full shows a ~1800px black gap after the first case, consistent with pinned case panels that render only while in view (inferred).
'DARKROOM' letters show horizontal-line/glitch texture that differs slightly between the last frames.
Last mobile frame replaces the footer with a full red 'backrooms' panel.

reduced_motion: No visible difference; running_animations 0 normal and 0 reduced (motion is JS/Lenis/video driven, not CSS animations).
mobile: At 393px the header becomes a square icon + centred wordmark + boxed hamburger. The H1 wraps to 2 lines at full width, the definition/manifesto stack with a full-width MANIFESTO button, and the order matches desktop. Case media go full-bleed, quotes stack, capabilities go 2-up, the activity log truncates rows with an ellipsis, the footer link columns go 2-up above the wordmark, and the red backrooms panel ends the page.
adaptable_ideas: One display face at one colour across all headings, everything else in small uppercase mono: two type sizes carry the whole hierarchy.
Hero H1 set edge to edge with justified word gaps, plus a 4-column mono row beneath (label, definition, pitch, CTA) as the only supporting grid.
Let the first case study's media peek in above the fold, then expand it to full-bleed on scroll as the transition out of the hero.
A dated activity log as a proof section: dense table rows show shipping cadence better than logos.
